units.leftText: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people. He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,
units.rightText: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another. He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:

units.leftText: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!” He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.
units.rightText: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!” He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.

units.leftText: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave. They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,
units.rightText: He sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave. They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,

units.leftText: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true. The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
units.rightText: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right. The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.

units.leftText: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions, to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.
units.rightText: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance, to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.

units.leftText: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham. He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.
units.rightText: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham. And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,

units.leftText: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants. He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
units.rightText: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants. He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.

units.leftText: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham. He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.
units.rightText: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham. He sent darkness, and it became dark— yet they defied His words.

units.leftText: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish. Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.
units.rightText: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die. Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.

units.leftText: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders. He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.
units.rightText: He spoke, and insects swarmed— gnats throughout their country. He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.

units.leftText: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country. He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.
units.rightText: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country. He spoke, and the locusts came— young locusts without number.

units.leftText: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground. He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.
units.rightText: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil. Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.

units.leftText: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes. Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
units.rightText: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled. Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.

units.leftText: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night. They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
units.rightText: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night. They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

units.leftText: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places. For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
units.rightText: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert. For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.

units.leftText: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing. He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,
units.rightText: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy. He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever. Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever. Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?

units.leftText: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times. Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,
units.rightText: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times. Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,

units.leftText: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance. We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.
units.rightText: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance. We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.

units.leftText: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea. Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.
units.rightText: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea. Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.

units.leftText: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert. He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
units.rightText: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert. He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

units.leftText: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left. Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.
units.rightText: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained. Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.

units.leftText: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel, but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.
units.rightText: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel. They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.

units.leftText: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul. They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.
units.rightText: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them. In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.

units.leftText: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram. A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.
units.rightText: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram. Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.

units.leftText: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image. Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
units.rightText: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image. They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.

units.leftText: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt, wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.
units.rightText: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt, wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.

units.leftText: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them. Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,
units.rightText: So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them. They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.

units.leftText: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice. Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,
units.rightText: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD. So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,

units.leftText: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands. They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
units.rightText: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands. They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.

units.leftText: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them. Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.
units.rightText: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them. But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.

units.leftText: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come. They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;
units.rightText: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come. At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.

units.leftText: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips. They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,
units.rightText: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips. They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,

units.leftText: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works. They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
units.rightText: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs. They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.

units.leftText: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons. They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.
units.rightText: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons. They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.

units.leftText: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds. Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.
units.rightText: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds. So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.

units.leftText: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them. Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.
units.rightText: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them. Their enemies oppressed them and subdued them under their hand.

units.leftText: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity. Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.
units.rightText: Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity. Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.

units.leftText: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses. He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.
units.rightText: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion. He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.

units.leftText: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise! Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise. Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever. Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
units.rightText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever. Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy

units.leftText: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south. They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.
units.rightText: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south. Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.

units.leftText: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them. Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
units.rightText: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them. Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.

units.leftText: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in. Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!
units.rightText: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live. Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.

units.leftText: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good. Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,
units.rightText: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things. Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,

units.leftText: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High. Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.
units.rightText: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High. He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.

units.leftText: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses. He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.
units.rightText: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress. He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men! For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.
units.rightText: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men. For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.

units.leftText: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities. Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.
units.rightText: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction. They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.

units.leftText: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses. He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.
units.rightText: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress. He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men! Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.
units.rightText: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men. Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.

units.leftText: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters, these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.
units.rightText: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters. They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.

units.leftText: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves. They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.
units.rightText: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea. They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.

units.leftText: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end. Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.
units.rightText: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless. Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.

units.leftText: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still. Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.
units.rightText: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed. They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.

units.leftText: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men! Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.
units.rightText: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men. Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.

units.leftText: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground, and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
units.rightText: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground, and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.

units.leftText: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs. There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
units.rightText: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs. He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.

units.leftText: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase. He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
units.rightText: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest. He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.

units.leftText: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow. He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
units.rightText: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow, He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.

units.leftText: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock. The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.
units.rightText: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks. The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.

units.leftText: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul. Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
units.rightText: A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being. Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

units.leftText: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples. For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
units.rightText: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples. For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.

units.leftText: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth. That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
units.rightText: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth. Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.

units.leftText: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth. Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
units.rightText: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth. Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.

units.leftText: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.” Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
units.rightText: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.” Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

units.leftText: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies. Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.
units.rightText: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies? Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

units.leftText: God of my praise, don’t remain silent, for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.
units.rightText: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, be not silent. For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.

units.leftText: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause. In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.
units.rightText: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause. In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.

units.leftText: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love. Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.
units.rightText: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love. Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.

units.leftText: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin. Let his days be few. Let another take his office.
units.rightText: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin. May his days be few; may another take his position.

units.leftText: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow. Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.
units.rightText: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow. May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.

units.leftText: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor. Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.
units.rightText: May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor. May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.

units.leftText: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out. Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.
units.rightText: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation. May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.

units.leftText: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth; because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.
units.rightText: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth. For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted, even to their death.

units.leftText: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him. He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.
units.rightText: The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him. The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.

units.leftText: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him. This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.
units.rightText: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him. May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.

units.leftText: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me; for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
units.rightText: But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion. For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.

units.leftText: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust. My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.
units.rightText: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust. My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.

units.leftText: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head. Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;
units.rightText: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads. Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.

units.leftText: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it. They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.
units.rightText: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it. Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.

units.leftText: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe. I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.
units.rightText: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe. With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.

units.leftText: The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.” The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.
units.rightText: A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.” The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”

units.leftText: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth. The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
units.rightText: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth. The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

units.leftText: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath. He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.
units.rightText: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath. He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation. The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly. Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

units.leftText: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever. He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.
units.rightText: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever. He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

units.leftText: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant. He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.
units.rightText: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever. He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.

units.leftText: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure. They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.
units.rightText: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy. They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.

units.leftText: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome! The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!
units.rightText: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name. The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments. His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments. His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

units.leftText: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever. Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
units.rightText: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever. Light dawns in the darkness for the upright — for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.

units.leftText: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment. For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
units.rightText: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice. Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.

units.leftText: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD. His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
units.rightText: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD. His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.

units.leftText: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor. The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
units.rightText: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor. The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.

units.leftText: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name. Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.
units.rightText: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD. Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.

units.leftText: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised. The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
units.rightText: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised. The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.

units.leftText: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high, who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?
units.rightText: Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high? He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.

units.leftText: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap, that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
units.rightText: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.

units.leftText: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language, Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
units.rightText: When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue, Judah became God’s sanctuary, Israel His dominion.

units.leftText: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back. The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
units.rightText: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back; the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.

units.leftText: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back? You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?
units.rightText: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back, O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?

units.leftText: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob, who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.
units.rightText: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob, who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!

units.leftText: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake. Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”
units.rightText: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness. Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”

units.leftText: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases. Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
units.rightText: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases. Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

units.leftText: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see. They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.
units.rightText: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see; they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;

units.leftText: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat. Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.
units.rightText: they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats. Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

units.leftText: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield. House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
units.rightText: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield. O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

units.leftText: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield. The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.
units.rightText: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield. The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;

units.leftText: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great. May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.
units.rightText: He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike. May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.

units.leftText: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth. The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
units.rightText: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth. The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.

units.leftText: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence, but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence. But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore. Hallelujah!

units.leftText: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy. Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.
units.rightText: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice — my appeal for mercy. Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.

units.leftText: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow. Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”
units.rightText: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow. Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”

units.leftText: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful. The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
units.rightText: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion. The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.

units.leftText: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you. For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
units.rightText: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you. For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.

units.leftText: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living. I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”
units.rightText: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living. I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”

units.leftText: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.” What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
units.rightText: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!” How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?

units.leftText: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name. I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.
units.rightText: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD. I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.

units.leftText: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints. LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
units.rightText: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints. Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.

units.leftText: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name. I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,
units.rightText: I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD. I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,

units.leftText: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples! For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!
units.rightText: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples! For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!

units.leftText: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever. Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever. Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”

units.leftText: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever. Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.
units.rightText: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.” Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”

units.leftText: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom. The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
units.rightText: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free. The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

units.leftText: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me. It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.
units.rightText: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me. It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.

units.leftText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes. All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.
units.rightText: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes. All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

units.leftText: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off. They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
units.rightText: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off. They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

units.leftText: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me. The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
units.rightText: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me. The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.

units.leftText: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly. The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”
units.rightText: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor! The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”

units.leftText: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works. The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
units.rightText: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done. The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.

units.leftText: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD. This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.
units.rightText: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD. This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.

units.leftText: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation. The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
units.rightText: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation. The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

units.leftText: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes. This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
units.rightText: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes. This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

units.leftText: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now. Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.
units.rightText: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.

units.leftText: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar. You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
units.rightText: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar. You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.

units.leftText: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law. Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
units.rightText: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD. Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.

units.leftText: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways. You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.
units.rightText: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways. You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.

units.leftText: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes! Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.
units.rightText: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes! Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.

units.leftText: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments. I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH
units.rightText: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments. I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me. ב BETH

units.leftText: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word. With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
units.rightText: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word. With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.

units.leftText: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you. Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.
units.rightText: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You. Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.

units.leftText: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth. I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
units.rightText: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth. I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.

units.leftText: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways. I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL
units.rightText: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways. I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word. ג GIMEL

units.leftText: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word. Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
units.rightText: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word. Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.

units.leftText: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me. My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
units.rightText: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me. My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.

units.leftText: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments. Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.
units.rightText: You rebuke the arrogant — the cursed who stray from Your commandments. Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.

units.leftText: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes. Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH
units.rightText: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes. Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors. ד DALETH

units.leftText: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word! I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
units.rightText: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word. I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.

units.leftText: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works. My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
units.rightText: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders. My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.

units.leftText: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously! I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.
units.rightText: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law. I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.

units.leftText: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed. I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE
units.rightText: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame. I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart. ה HE

units.leftText: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end. Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
units.rightText: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end. Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.

units.leftText: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them. Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.
units.rightText: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight. Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.

units.leftText: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways. Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.
units.rightText: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word. Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.

units.leftText: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good. Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV
units.rightText: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good. How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness. ו WAW

units.leftText: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word. So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.
units.rightText: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise. Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.

units.leftText: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances. So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.
units.rightText: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments. I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.

units.leftText: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts. I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.
units.rightText: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts. I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.

units.leftText: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them. I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN
units.rightText: I delight in Your commandments because I love them. I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes. ז ZAYIN

units.leftText: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope. This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.
units.rightText: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope. This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.

units.leftText: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law. I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.
units.rightText: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law. I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.

units.leftText: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law. Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.
units.rightText: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law. Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.

units.leftText: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law. This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH
units.rightText: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law. This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts. ח HETH

units.leftText: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words. I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.
units.rightText: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words. I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.

units.leftText: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes. I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
units.rightText: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies. I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.

units.leftText: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law. At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.
units.rightText: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law. At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.

units.leftText: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts. The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH
units.rightText: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts. The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes. ט TETH

units.leftText: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD. Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.
units.rightText: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word. Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.

units.leftText: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word. You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.
units.rightText: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word. You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.

units.leftText: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts. Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.
units.rightText: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart. Their hearts are callous and insensitive, but I delight in Your law.

units.leftText: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes. The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH
units.rightText: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes. The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. י YODH

units.leftText: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments. Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.
units.rightText: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments. May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.

units.leftText: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me. Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.
units.rightText: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me. May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.

units.leftText: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight. Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.
units.rightText: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight. May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.

units.leftText: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes. Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF
units.rightText: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies. May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame. כ KAPH

units.leftText: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word. My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”
units.rightText: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word. My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”

units.leftText: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes. How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?
units.rightText: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes. How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?

units.leftText: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law. All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!
units.rightText: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law. All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause— help me!

units.leftText: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts. Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH
units.rightText: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts. Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth. ל LAMEDH

units.leftText: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever. Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.
units.rightText: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens. Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.

units.leftText: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you. Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.
units.rightText: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You. If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.

units.leftText: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me. I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
units.rightText: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me. I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.

units.leftText: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes. I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM
units.rightText: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies. I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit. מ MEM

units.leftText: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day. Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.
units.rightText: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation. Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.

units.leftText: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation. I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.
units.rightText: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation. I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.

units.leftText: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word. I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
units.rightText: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word. I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.

units.leftText: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth! Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN
units.rightText: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth! I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way. נ NUN

units.leftText: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path. I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.
units.rightText: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path. I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.

units.leftText: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word. Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.
units.rightText: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word. Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.

units.leftText: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law. The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.
units.rightText: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law. The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.

units.leftText: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart. I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH
units.rightText: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart. I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end. ס SAMEKH

units.leftText: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law. You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.
units.rightText: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love. You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.

units.leftText: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God. Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
units.rightText: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God. Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.

units.leftText: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually. You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.
units.rightText: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes. You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.

units.leftText: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies. My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN
units.rightText: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies. My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments. ע AYIN

units.leftText: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors. Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.
units.rightText: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors. Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.

units.leftText: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word. Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
units.rightText: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise. Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.

units.leftText: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies. It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.
units.rightText: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies. It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.

units.leftText: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold. Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE
units.rightText: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold. Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way. פ PE

units.leftText: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them. The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.
units.rightText: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them. The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.

units.leftText: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments. Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
units.rightText: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments. Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.

units.leftText: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me. Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.
units.rightText: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me. Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.

units.leftText: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes. Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE
units.rightText: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes. My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed. צ TZADE

units.leftText: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright. You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
units.rightText: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments. The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.

units.leftText: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words. Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
units.rightText: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words. Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.

units.leftText: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts. Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.
units.rightText: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts. Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.

units.leftText: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight. Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH
units.rightText: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight. Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. ק KOPH

units.leftText: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes. I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.
units.rightText: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes. I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.

units.leftText: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words. My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.
units.rightText: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope. My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.

units.leftText: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances. They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.
units.rightText: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice. Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.

units.leftText: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth. Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH
units.rightText: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true. Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever. ר RESH

units.leftText: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law. Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.
units.rightText: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law. Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.

units.leftText: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes. Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.
units.rightText: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes. Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.

units.leftText: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies. I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.
units.rightText: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies. I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.

units.leftText: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness. All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN
units.rightText: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion. The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever. ש SIN and SHIN

units.leftText: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words. I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.
units.rightText: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word. I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.

units.leftText: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law. Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
units.rightText: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love. Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.

units.leftText: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble. I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.
units.rightText: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble. I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.

units.leftText: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly. I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV
units.rightText: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly. I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You. ת TAW

units.leftText: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word. Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.
units.rightText: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word. May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.

units.leftText: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes. Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.
units.rightText: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes. My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.

units.leftText: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts. I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.
units.rightText: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts. I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.

units.leftText: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me. I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.
units.rightText: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me. I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.

units.leftText: In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me. Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.
units.rightText: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me. Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.

units.leftText: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue? Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
units.rightText: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue? Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!

units.leftText: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar! My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.
units.rightText: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar! Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.

units.leftText: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
units.rightText: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come? My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

units.leftText: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber. Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
units.rightText: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber. Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

units.leftText: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand. The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
units.rightText: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand. The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.

units.leftText: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul. The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
units.rightText: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul. The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.

units.leftText: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!” Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!
units.rightText: A song of ascents. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.” Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.

units.leftText: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together, where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.
units.rightText: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together, where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.

units.leftText: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house. Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
units.rightText: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David. Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.

units.leftText: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces. For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
units.rightText: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.” For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”

units.leftText: I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens. Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.
